Welcome to 90/10 Mentality

The EDGE you need... with the CONNECTION you deserve!

Athletes deserve more than drills — they deserve connection. At 90/10 Mentality we train the mind and the body, because softball and baseball are 90% mental and 10% physical. We play to win, but the growth, confidence, and joy gained here last a lifetime.

Birthday Parties

Throw a birthday party at 90/10 Mentality. Party guests get time in the cages for hitting games and friendly competition, with staff on hand to run the activities and keep things moving. It's an active, no-stress way to celebrate — we handle the fun, you bring the cake.

Ask About a Party

Speed + Agility Clinics

Speed shows up everywhere on the diamond — beating out a throw, tracking down a fly ball, stealing a base. These clinics build first-step quickness, change of direction, and overall athleticism with drills athletes can keep using on their own. Watch the calendar for upcoming clinic dates.

Ask About Speed + Agility

Coaches Clinics

Built for youth and high school coaches who want better practices and better-prepared players. Coaches clinics cover drill progressions, practice planning, and how to teach the mental side of the game — led by a coach with over 200 career wins and six state tournament appearances.

Ask About Coaches Clinics

Workbooks

The game is 90% mental — these workbooks train that 90%. Athletes work through goal setting, confidence, routines, and handling failure, at their own pace. A great companion to lessons and clinics, and a tool coaches can use with a whole team.

Ask About Workbooks

Skills Clinics

Focused group training on the skills that decide games — hitting, fielding, pitching, and catching. Clinics are scheduled throughout the year, including Friday pitching & catching sessions for members. Check the calendar for the next clinic and how to sign up.

Ask About Skills Clinics

1-on-1 Remote

Can't get to Davenport? Train with 90/10 from anywhere. Send in video of your swing or pitching motion and get personal analysis, feedback, and a plan to work on between check-ins — the same coaching eye, delivered remotely.

Ask About Remote Coaching
